purpose: Turn the static Knowledge Relation Plane into an automatically refreshed Evidence Knowledge Graph and add deterministic hypothesis novelty/convergence analysis without inheriting scientific authority.

stage_4.name: Evidence-Bus -> automatically growing knowledge graph
stage_4.materiality_rule: A new graph edge is emitted only from an explicit structured field or a deterministic normalized signature match. Weak text coincidence is stored as a low-confidence discovery hint, never as an accepted scientific relation.
stage_4.incremental_rule: Recompute only when the input manifest changes; the event-bus controller checks the manifest during the active wave window.
stage_4.no_authority_rule: Graph nodes and edges cannot authorize performance, holdout selection, ranking, tuning, promotion or live execution.

stage_5.name: Automatic hypothesis novelty/convergence check

classes.POTENTIAL_CONVERGENCE: high deterministic signature overlap; human/scientific review required
classes.AMBIGUOUS: intermediate overlap; retain both lineages until evidence resolves distinction
classes.LIKELY_ORTHOGONAL: low overlap under the frozen signature contract

stage_5.proposal_rule: A bridge proposal is generated only when candidates share a clock/component but have materially different mechanism tokens. It is a reviewable hypothesis proposal, not a candidate and not evidence.
stage_5.anti_duplicate_rule: Do not create a new candidate when deterministic convergence indicates a repackaging of an existing lineage. Route to review/merge analysis instead.
stage_5.no_optimization_rule: Novelty/convergence scores may prioritize research effort and consolidation only; they may not optimize trading parameters, assets, thresholds, horizons or returns.

negative_evidence.fail_closed_rule: A negative or contradictory relation is retained with provenance and is never silently converted into a neutral state.

continuous_wave.early_exit_allowed_when: the wave is explicitly superseded, the repository becomes unavailable, or a hard safety/capacity constraint prevents continuation
